result.title: Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head for Tiny Vision-Language-Action Models
result.summary: Real-time onboard robot control calls for a lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) model, yet shrinking the backbone leaves less capacity for deliberation at inference time. Chain-of-thought decoding, dual-system architectures, and larger backbones can restore deliberation but reintroduce the latency and memory costs that motivated going small. Recurrent action heads offer a lighter alternative by iterating in latent space before committing to an action, but existing designs refine a single undifferentiated state that must simultaneously encode slowly evolving task context and rapidly changing motor commands. We propose the Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH), which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies: a low-level state that updates fast, grounded in action tokens and proprioception, and a high-level state that updates slowly, grounded in visual understanding and the instruction-informed low-level state. The two states exchange information through nested reasoning cycles. Because all iteration occurs in the compact head after a single backbone pass, HR-AH adds hierarchical reasoning without increasing the backbone size. With a 22.5M-parameter head, 3-4.3x smaller than those of RD-VLA and VLA-Adapter on the same backbone, HR-AH reaches 97.0% success rate on LIBERO and a 4.40 average chain length on CALVIN ABC->D, at the lowest latency among compared methods. We show that this hierarchy improves performance over a parameter-matched single-state head, and that routing distinct modalities to each level yields further gains in both accuracy and inference cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出分层推理动作头 HR-AH：在单次 backbone 前向之后，于紧凑 head 内维护快、慢两个 latent 状态，通过嵌套推理循环交换信息后再输出动作，在小参数量下取得 LIBERO/CALVIN 上的较好成功率与低延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 快/慢双 latent 状态与不同更新频率的设计，可能为 LVR 中「缓慢任务上下文」与「快速视觉证据」的分层状态表示及推理深度分配提供借鉴线索，但该文面向机器人动作控制，迁移到多模态推理仍需核查。
